description: Defines classes and structures for aggregating MAC layer metrics, including configuration, report handling, and cell management within the ocudu namespace.

classes.name: mac_metrics_aggregator
classes.description: Class responsible for aggregating MAC component metrics, managing cell reports, and handling report timing.

methods.name: add_cell
methods.description: Adds a new cell to the metrics aggregator with specified configuration.

methods.name: rem_cell
methods.description: Removes a cell from the metrics aggregator.

methods.name: handle_pending_reports
methods.description: Processes any reports that are pending.

methods.name: handle_cell_activation
methods.description: Handles activation of a cell and prepares reporting.

methods.name: pop_report
methods.description: Retrieves a report from the report ring.

methods.name: try_send_new_report
methods.description: Attempts to create and send a new aggregated report.
